name: Afghanistan (Taliban, 1996–1997)
history: The plain white flag flown by the Taliban when they took Kabul on 27 September 1996 and proclaimed the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan, white standing for the purity of their faith and government. For a year it was the only single-colour national flag in the world apart from Libya's green; on 27 October 1997 the shahada was added in black.
